argv: for f in /schemas/*.schema.json; do b=$(basename "$f" .schema.json); out=$(timeout 20 /opt/codex/bin/codex exec --json --ephemeral --skip-git-repo-check -C /workspace --output-schema "$f" -c 'model_provider="fake"' -c 'model_providers.fake={name="Fake", base_url="http://fakeprov:8080/v1", env_key="FAKE_PROVIDER_KEY", wire_api="responses", supports_websockets=false}' --disable plugins --disable apps --disable remote_plugin --disable tool_suggest --disable image_generation --disable plugin_sharing -c analytics.enabled=false -c feedback.enabled=false -c check_for_update_on_startup=false 'say hello' 2>&1 | head -c 260 | tr '\n' ' '); echo "$b | $out"; done
